text: The slot holds the head `discriminant + sentences` for `tinyclip-8m-16` (shrinkage 0.03, species_com, gamma 1), fitted on `images/alachua-2025 (two thirds of val)`, with 5911 species rows, and a bias a row. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 0.5, w_kind 0.5, alpha_prior 0.5. On 565 tuning photos (the third of val kept for tuning) the thresholds came out as name_at never (no level reached nine in ten) and offer_at 0.24. On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 79.5% (78.3 to 80.7); the top species is right for 25.3% (24.0 to 26.6) and is among the first five for 45.4% (43.9 to 46.9). `person` was said for 0.14% of these photos and `none` for 0.24%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind rows fitted on the fitting photos and the extra set (every kind counts the same)`. With kind_at 0.53 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 52.9% (51.4 to 54.4) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 95.4% (94.5 to 96.2) of those; for the 47.1% (45.6 to 48.6) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 88.6% (87.2 to 90.0). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds.wasm-int8-per-channel`), the kind is right for 96.2% (95.2 to 97.3); the page asserts a kind for 70.5% (68.0 to 73.1) and is right for 99.3% (98.7 to 99.8) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 94.3% (91.8 to 96.5). A species is named on 0.0% (0.0 to 0.0) of these photos. The slot needs: species.bias_url (build 7 of the page); kinds.bias (build 7 of the page); fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).
